en.content:
Match List-I with List-II

List-I List-II
(A) Moment of inertia of solid sphere of radius R about any tangent. (I)
(B) Moment of inertia of hollow sphere of radius (R) about any tangent. (II)
(C) Moment of inertia of circular ring of radius (R) about its diameter. (III)
(D) Moment of inertia of circular disc of radius (R) about any diameter. (IV)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: A - II, B - I, C - IV, D - III
A - I, B - II, C - IV, D - III
A - II, B - I, C - III, D - IV
A - I, B - II, C - III, D - IV

en.explanation:
(A) Moment of inertia of solid sphere of radius R about a tangent

A (II)

(B) Moment of inertia of hollow sphere of radius R about a tangent

B (I)

(C) Moment of inertia of circular ring of radius (R) about its diameter =

C (IV)

(D) Moment of inertia of circular disc of radius (R) about any diameter

D (III)

hi.content:
सूची-I का सूची-II से मिलान करें -

सूची-I सूची-II
